shots: 01-little-words

Close tabletop view of a soft well-loved cream bunny toy sitting beside a child's small wooden toy telephone, a toddler's hand offering the bunny a toy cup. Diffuse afternoon light, background dark sage wall. A different setting from a kitchen and banana.
01-little-words

Three generations represented by one adult hand, an older grandparent hand and one toddler hand pointing at a small toy dog on a low wooden living-room table. Warm home interior, tactile objects, no faces. Upper background softly blurred plain wall.
01-little-words

Over-the-shoulder crop of a parent at a desk holding a pencil over a completely blank cream notebook, a small printed candid photo showing a yellow rain boot beside it. Lower half composition. No writing, a single purposeful journaling scene, morning window light.
01-little-words

Low close-up of a small child in yellow rain boots pointing up at a duck beside a quiet garden path; only child's legs and one hand seen, no face. Subject duck and boots in lower frame, upper half dark soft garden bokeh. Gentle storybook real photography.
02-first-laugh

Playful peekaboo scene, a caregiver hiding their face behind an open plain cream board book held low in the frame, only hands and knitted sleeves visible, a baby's small hand reaching toward the book. No text or illustrations on cover, blurred warm living-room wall above.
02-first-laugh

Intimate low close-up of baby hands reaching for shimmering soap bubbles in soft afternoon garden light. Caregiver's arm visibly supports baby below frame, no face visible. Three or four bubbles lower half, upper half muted olive bokeh. No socks or puppet.
02-first-laugh

Two seated adults' hands meeting a baby's little hands above a soft mustard play mat; one older adult in oatmeal sleeve and one parent in sage sleeve. Affectionate family play from low angle, cropped torsos only, natural anatomy. Quiet living room in upper half.
02-first-laugh

A small curious fluffy brown family dog tilting its head toward a bright red soft toy ball beside a baby's feet, supervised caregiver hand holding the ball; no faces, calm indoor scene. Dog and small feet in lower half, blurred cream sofa upper half.
03-bedtime

Close crop of a parent in a sage sweater holding an awake baby securely upright against their chest while gently swaying in a dim hallway; only back of baby's head and parent's torso and supporting hands. Warm amber lamplight lower side, upper background dark plain wall. No fingers being held.
03-bedtime

Quiet nursery still life: two different adult slippers, one large dark pair and one small oatmeal pair, set beside a wooden rocking chair with a cream knitted cardigan over its arm. Warm evening side light, lower-frame objects, dark blurred room above. No people or infant.
03-bedtime

Bedside oak table with a blank open cream notebook, a plain pencil, a warm shaded lamp, and one tiny neatly folded sage cotton baby sleepsuit. Close editorial detail, notebook in lower frame, soft dark upper wall, no text, no screens.
03-bedtime

Close-up of a parent's hand switching off a small warm bedside lamp on a wooden side table, beside a closed plain linen-covered picture book and a tiny cotton sock. Peaceful evening, lower-half objects, rich muted olive shadow in upper half. No child or bed.
